sources.name: Pegasus DL
sources.description: Direct package downloader for PS5 with a local web interface, catalog sources, queue management and file management.

sources.name: Orbit Store (Beta)
sources.description: A modern PS5 download manager with a native TV app, resumable downloads and phone controls.

sources.name: OnionHEN
sources.description: All-in-one PS5 HEN and Toolbox with payload management, cheats, overlays and background services.

sources.name: WebKit Autoloader
sources.description: Installer payload that sets up a fully offline WebKit exploit autoloader served from the console itself.

sources.name: Prospero Manager
sources.description: Web-based all-in-one PS5 manager for files, payloads, PKGs, saves, processes, thermal controls and more.

sources.name: Game Compressor
sources.description: Standalone PS5 payload for compressing, unpacking, validating, repairing and moving ShadowMountPlus-mounted games.

sources.name: APR Emu Updater
sources.description: Keeps APR Emu up to date on installed PS5 titles from a web interface on the console.

sources.name: AnyPad
sources.description: Resident payload that connects DualShock 4, Xbox, Switch Pro, 8BitDo and other Bluetooth gamepads as virtual DualSense controllers.

sources.name: OmniPad
sources.description: Universal controller engine with USB/2.4GHz hotplug and a web dashboard for third-party pads on jailbroken PS5s.
